name: V35.coverage-split-2d-table
description: ADR-0039 — a 2-D factor table (Sample BOP 2025 base_lc_property, territory × coverage) rates the correct column per coverage tower. The Building and BPP towers each consume a 1-D lookup.direct that is the table's building / bpp COLUMN, sliced at projection time (stagesToRuntimePlan.sliceCellsToCoverageColumn). Fed the SAME territory (701), the two columns return DIFFERENT, correct factors — Building 0.389, BPP 0.199 — proving the coverage axis selects the column rather than collapsing to the neutral 1.0. This is the portable record of the brief-53 acceptance; a non-TS engine port that slices a 2-D coverage table to per-tower 1-D lookups matches the same outputs.

plan.name: Coverage-split base loss cost (territory 701 → Building 0.389 / BPP 0.199)
